description: The targets each UK build calibrates to (microcosm#1759): the level rule that places every compiled UK target at one geography level, the full build's selection of its solve surface by level, and the two calibration lines. microcosm.calibrate.target_sets reads this file; microcosm.build.uk_runtime.target_sets names its products. The US declares its target sets the same way, in us/target_sets.json (microcosm#1728).

level_rule.rationale: A compiled UK target names its level in its local metadata (geography_level), in the Ledger's (ledger_geography_level), or in both. Both must then agree, and the level must be one of the five grains a UK build calibrates at; any other target is refused, not placed by a guess. This is the rule the UK resolver uk_runtime.graph_targets.target_geography applied in code before microcosm#1759.

levels.description: The full (local-line) build's solve surface: the compiled targets of the levels the build requests, all of them by default, in compile order, with a receipt that lists every target (uk.full.target_selection@1). The node first applies the build's family filter (--households-only) and, with no area BRMAs, drops the brma rows.

compiled.rationale: The country-level rows. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.
The region-level rows. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.
The Westminster constituency cells. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.
The local-authority cells. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.

The Broad Rental Market Area cells. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset. With no area BRMAs (--brma-localisation none) the node drops these rows before it selects, because they would bind on the spine's regional BRMA draw (microcosm#1305).

national.description: The national line's solve surface (load_uk_national_target_inputs and the release-cut certifier): the compiled national registry less the references whose contract target binds on the local line only. They leave right after the compile, before reconciliation, the measure exclusions and the frozen-register check (microcosm#1301).

compiled.rationale: A contract target binds on every line unless its calibration_lines field in uk/uk_population_targets.json narrows it; the field and its reason stay with the target, and uk_runtime.ledger_targets passes this clause the targets it leaves out. The high-value homes region rows bind on the local line only (microcosm#1240, microcosm#1301): on the national line they would move the national registry and solve while the Land Registry knots' tails place more homes in the top bands than the derived stock (microcosm#1112).

local.description: The local line's national rows (load_uk_full_target_inputs; the full dense build binds them beside the local surface): the compiled national registry less the references whose contract target binds on the national line only, dropped at the same point.

compiled.rationale: A contract target binds on every line unless its calibration_lines field in uk/uk_population_targets.json narrows it; the field and its reason stay with the target, and uk_runtime.ledger_targets passes this clause the targets it leaves out. The CenTax childcare-parent bands bind on the national line only (microcosm#1399).
